capabilities: Browse properties, values and notes in an expandable tree
Search property names, values, note names and folder paths
Save property views with folder filters and exclusions
Bulk rename, merge, delete and convert property values with preview and undo
Convert inline fields in note bodies into YAML properties
extras: Detailed user guides live in external documentation linked from the README. Undo covers only the last successful batch and lasts until the plugin reloads. Edits can change YAML comments and quoting, and renaming a property does not update its configured type, templates or queries. Inline property browsing requires version 1.5.0 or later; the plugin needs Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
motivation: Design and concept inspired by RedPandaLi's idea of Scoped Properties.
problem: Obsidian's Properties view shows one note's metadata at a time, so finding notes by a property value or fixing inconsistent property names and values across many notes is manual work.

relations.evidence: Design and concept inspired by @RedPandaLi|RedPandaLi's idea of Scoped Properties.

summary: Property browser that lists properties, their values and the notes using them, with bulk rename, merge, delete and undo.
